verdict.rationale: Floot documents an official remote MCP server that lets AI clients such as Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Claude and ChatGPT drive the product programmatically. Its documented tools cover logs, database reads and writes, schema pulls, checkpoints and image generation. However, no conventional public REST API is evidenced, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404, so programmatic control is available only through the MCP channel. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec, API-key/auth and rate-limit documentation, coverage of project creation and publishing via API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
